name: dsh-vn-master
description: Master: the pack's base bundle for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - one no-op 'master' host row plus the bundle layer, installed LAST so it is the pack's final word on any row. It ships no browser half, provides no service and declares no inject edge, so the right bar's tab-type chain stays exactly where it is. What it carries is the pack's statements about shipped ROWS: alpha.2 re-enables the right Sidebar's Browser tab, which 0.2 declares desktop-only, because this pack targets the raw WEB profile - the browser package then registers its tab type and its own Start-page guide entry with no pack code involved; alpha.3 REMOVES the feedback surface entirely, which is a product decision rather than a row replacement, so it belongs here: ui-message-feedback (the Like/Dislike action strip, the Submit-feedback dialog and its toast, the /feedback composer decoration and the feedbackUi service), message-feedback and command-feedback (the two host halves: the messageFeedback and sessionFeedback Remotes and the log-only feedback events they append) and session-telemetry-otel (the FEEDBACK_ONLY export path that ships a Session-log prefix to the vendor's collector once a feedback event exists - the launcher's own privacy switch, so the exporter is never constructed). The account menu's hardcoded Feedback item is not a row and is hidden by dsh-themes. Alpha.
